review:
A western 243-ways game with multiplier wilds – and one of the weirdest bonuses around. Three bonus symbols start free spins.

At the start, the game picks one sticky symbol and turns every position into a wooden box. Each spin cracks some boxes open, revealing that symbol, a multiplier or +1 spin – but nothing pays until the end. Your win depends on how many sticky symbols you uncovered, and five multipliers boost it further. Medium-high volatility, 5,000x max, 97% RTP, bonus about once every 123 spins.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 123 spins on average)
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
